cusum_minimality.m5_tail_note: cells 305-309 fail for m=5 because the curvature slack rho*x*M_R2 exceeds |g_mid_hi|; mu_k improves only through the accumulated l chain, so closing them through K5-B needs an unbroken order-3 run 0-309, a tightened K1 R'' enclosure there, or acceptance of K5_INCONCLUSIVE for m=5 on approximately (1.62, 2]
cusum_minimality.method: the frozen Theorem K5-B recurrences evaluated on the certified CUSUM K1 records with L_k = -infinity (no order-3 evidence), exact rational arithmetic
cusum_minimality.smallest_defensible_campaign: cells 0-148 (149 cells) for m in {1,2,3}, plus an explicit decision on the m=5 tail 305-309
cusum_minimality.z2_never_fires: no cell, for any m, has R2_interval.lo > 0: the whole tail is carried by the direct bound Gamma_k

order3_reuse.detail: CUSUM records carry auxiliary_third_derivative_evidence_v1 (S_r:3, W_(r,j):3, h_j:3 suprema and order-3 midpoint error nodes), but every value is mag_fraction = max(|lo|,|hi|), an unsigned magnitude. The bridge needs a signed lower bound L_k <= inf R'''. No sign, and no R''' enclosure, is derivable from the committed records. SR has no order-3 record at all.
order3_reuse.reused_without_recomputation: R_interval, D_interval, R2_interval and M_R2 per m, which is what the minimality scan uses to remove 156 cells from the CUSUM campaign

probe_review.finding: CUSUM cell 221 lies inside 149-304, the region now proved not to need order-3 evidence for any m, while the newly identified difficult region is 305-309. A stronger minimal set would be CUSUM {0, 148, 305}.
probe_review.action_taken: none; the probe set is frozen pre-result and must not be edited. Adopting a different set requires a new predeclared successor oracle.

scope: This record audits readiness of the proposed K5 order-3 evidence campaign. It is not a K5 verdict, not an H3a verdict, not a K1 or P5Y verdict, and it authorizes no production. It changes no frozen artifact.

sr_geometry_risk.detail: The RHO_CAP rule ties rho to C_upper, so the PS1 cells where K5 needs R''' most sit at the same resolvent self-consistency product as the cell where the Aux3 fourth-order tower failed. The K5 test is a sign test rather than the 1/20 cover budget, so this is a strong risk signal, not a proof of infeasibility.
